title: Your First Weekend at Chapman University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off with Academic Brunch
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Welcome
cards.notes: Join fellow students and faculty for a welcome brunch on this historic lawn to start your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn used for major orientation gatherings and academic welcome events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bert Williams Mall hosts the Academic Partners Brunch for new students during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Orientation | Chapman University: Welcome New Students
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; specific orientation events require student registration.

cards.title: Gather at the Campus Heart
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Social
cards.notes: Meet up by the Marion Halfacre Fountain to cool off and connect with new friends in the university's central hub.
cards.short_summary: The central gathering place of campus featuring an Italian-inspired fountain and four pillars.
cards.evidence_claim: Attallah Piazza is centrally located and serves as a primary gathering place for student events and daily interaction.
cards.source_title: Make a Day of It: Experience Chapman

cards.title: Dinner at 'The Caf'
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Meal
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the main dining hall, featuring stations for pizza, sushi, and allergen-free options.
cards.short_summary: Chapman's primary resident dining hall located within the Sandhu Conference Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Randall Dining Commons is the main cafeteria and offers dinner service until 8:00 PM during orientation week.
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM during orientation; requires meal plan or payment.

cards.title: Explore the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Activities
cards.notes: Visit the 'living room of campus' to check out student galleries or grab a late-night snack at the ghost kitchen.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for student organizations, dining, and social lounging.
cards.evidence_claim: The Argyros Forum Student Union serves as the campus living room and houses student involvement offices and dining.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; specific dining hours vary by vendor.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Discovery
cards.notes: Scope out the five floors of resources and find a quiet carrel or a group study room for the semester ahead.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library featuring specialized archives and extensive study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Leatherby Libraries is open on weekends, typically from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM during summer/orientation periods.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Chapman ID required for some services.

cards.title: Immerse in California Art
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Culture
cards.notes: Walk across the tracks to see narrative art and animation history. Online reservations are recommended.
cards.short_summary: A museum dedicated to the 'California Scene' painting movement and narrative art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilbert Museum offers free admission and is open Wednesday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; free online reservations recommended.

cards.entity_name: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.title: Tour the STEM Hub
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Walk
cards.notes: Walk through the massive 140,000-square-foot facility to see the labs and collaborative 'hallway' study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art facility housing the Schmid College of Science and Technology and Fowler School of Engineering.
cards.evidence_claim: The Keck Center is a major campus landmark spanning two city blocks with specialized labs and student-led tours.
cards.source_title: Keck Center for Science and Engineering - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: General building access during business hours; labs require specific authorization.

cards.title: Catch a Performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Show
cards.notes: Check the calendar for world-class productions or student performances in this intimate 1,044-seat venue.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts center on campus known for its superior acoustics and design.
cards.evidence_claim: Musco Center hosts a variety of performances and offers students opportunities to perform and engage with artists.
cards.source_title: The Center - Musco Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Access depends on event schedule; ticket purchase typically required for shows.

cards.title: Reflect and Recharge
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Quiet
cards.notes: Visit this architectural masterpiece for a moment of meditation or to explore the diverse religious life resources.
cards.short_summary: A multi-faith center designed to support the spiritual and religious life of the Chapman community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fish Interfaith Center provides students of all faiths space to study, meditate, and pray.
cards.access_notes: Open to students for meditation and prayer; check for specific service times.

cards.title: Explore the Plaza
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Outing
cards.notes: Walk two blocks to the historic district for local dining and a look at the charming antique shops and cafes.
cards.short_summary: A historic district adjacent to campus featuring the famous Orange Plaza traffic circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapman is located just two blocks from Old Towne Orange, a historic district with numerous dining options.
cards.access_notes: Public historic district; walkable from campus.
